causal_scenarios.effect_np: the drop in winter energy bills
causal_scenarios.alternative_cause: The county's weatherization grant ran in the same year, and nearly all of the households that installed panels also used it to replace their windows and insulation.
causal_scenarios.reverse_causation: Households already paying less for energy are the ones with the disposable income to install panels in the first place.
causal_scenarios.sampling_flaw: The figures cover only the eleven households that returned the county's voluntary follow-up survey, out of several hundred that installed panels.
inert_facts: The county's solar permitting office took longer to process each application last year than it had in the year before the study began.
Panel prices fell steadily across the state over the period studied, as they have in every state with a comparable installation programme.
Most of the households included in the figures had lived at their current address for more than a decade before the programme opened.
The county publishes its household energy figures in a quarterly bulletin that it has issued in the same format since 2019.
causal_scenarios.control_comparison: Households in a neighbouring county with the same weather and the same utility rates, but no solar programme, saw no comparable change in winter bills.

causal_scenarios.alternative_cause: The same corridors had their speed limits lowered by ten miles per hour in the month the lanes opened.
causal_scenarios.reverse_causation: The city chose its safest corridors first, precisely because installing lanes there was least disruptive.
causal_scenarios.sampling_flaw: Only corridors that reported their collision data voluntarily are included in the comparison, and reporting was left to each corridor's own district office.
inert_facts: The lanes were funded by a state transport grant rather than from the city's own capital budget, as several earlier projects had been.
Cycling has grown steadily more popular nationally over the past decade, in cities with protected lanes and in cities without them alike.
Two of the corridors that received lanes are noticeably longer than the others, and one of them crosses a river.
The city repaints the markings on all of its lane infrastructure every eighteen months under a standing maintenance contract.
causal_scenarios.control_comparison: Corridors of similar width and traffic volume that did not receive lanes recorded no change in collisions over the same period.

ratio_scenarios.early_period: the first year of the programme
ratio_scenarios.base_change: The number of licensed contractors in the county nearly doubled over the same period.
inert_facts: The county raised its permit fee midway through the period.
Violations are recorded by the same office that issues the permits.
Neighbouring counties do not publish comparable figures.
The county publishes its violation figures in an annual report.
